description: This file defines an AutoMapper mapping profile for the Users feature in the Conduit project, setting up object-to-object mapping between Domain.Person and User classes.

classes.name: MappingProfile
classes.description: A class inheriting from AutoMapper.Profile that configures object mappings specific to the Users feature.

methods.name: MappingProfile
methods.description: Constructor that sets up a mapping from Domain.Person to User without member validation.
